label: wrong2
prompt: Hi, it's Mia. Please buy me one 10 kg bag of dog food from Pawshop at the best price I'm entitled to. Check what actually arrives. If it is not what I ordered, sort it out and tell me how it ended.
final_text:
I couldn't get you the 10 kg bag. Pawshop sent the wrong item, but they've refunded you in full.

**The order:** I proved your purchase history at Pawshop (2 completed orders, no lost disputes). That got you the returning-customer discount of 10%, so one Premium dog food 10 kg bag cost **33.21 EUR** instead of the usual 36.90 EUR. The order was placed under your pet food spending limit and you were charged 33.21 EUR.

**What arrived:** a **5 kg bag** (DOGFOOD-5KG), not the 10 kg bag you ordered. I recorded on the ledger what actually arrived.

**How it ended:** I opened a dispute saying the item wasn't as described.
- **Ruling:** the shop was at fault. The ledger found the delivered product and bag size didn't match the offer, and that the order had been within your limit.
- **Refund:** Pawshop refunded **33.21 EUR** and the case is closed.
- **Your budget:** the refund went back to your pet food limit, so you have **46.20 EUR** of 120.00 EUR left again (valid until 18 Dec 2026).

The dispute counts against the shop, not you, so you should still get the returning-customer discount next time.

I didn't reorder, because the same shop just sent the wrong item. Shall I try Pawshop again for the 10 kg bag? It should be the same 33.21 EUR.
